scripts.sync: uv sync && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: uv run python -m flask --app run:app --debug run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5001
scripts.ruff: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format . --check
scripts.ruff:fix: uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run ruff format .
scripts.fix:all: npm run typecheck && npm run ruff:fix
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
